cases.title: Home redirects to sign-in
steps: Open the site root.
cases.expected: Lands on /login. No project names anywhere.

cases.title: Deep link survives sign-in
steps: Open /p/<a project id> while signed out.
Sign in with a member account.
cases.expected: Redirected to /login, then straight back into that project after sign-in.

cases.title: Admin page is closed
steps: Open /admin.
cases.expected: Redirected to /login.

cases.title: API refuses strangers
steps: Open /api/projects in the address bar.
cases.expected: A 401 JSON error, no data.

cases.title: PDF links don't leak
steps: Signed in elsewhere, copy a PDF's URL from the network tab.
Open it in the private window.
cases.expected: Redirect to sign-in or 401. The PDF never downloads.

cases.title: Wrong credentials say nothing specific
steps: Sign in with a real email and a wrong password.
Then with an email that has no account.
cases.expected: Both say "email or password is incorrect".

cases.title: Repeated failures are throttled
steps: Fail six sign-ins in a row for the same email.
cases.expected: The sixth says "too many failed attempts — wait 15 minutes".

cases.title: Sign-up form checks input
steps: On /signup try: mismatched passwords, a 9-character password, a malformed email, an email that already has an account.
cases.expected: A clear inline error for each, and no account is created.

cases.title: Sign-up waits for approval
steps: Request an account with valid details.
Try to sign in with it.
cases.expected: "Request sent…" confirmation, then sign-in says the account is waiting for approval.

cases.title: Bad invite link
steps: Open /join/not-a-real-token.
cases.expected: Sign-in page with "This invite link isn't valid."

cases.title: No open redirect after sign-in
steps: Open /login?next=https://example.com and sign in.
cases.expected: Lands on this site's home, never on the other site.

cases.title: Password help points to the admin
steps: Look under the sign-in form.
cases.expected: Says to ask the AnnotAid administrator. There is no "forgot password" email flow.

cases.title: Temporary password forces a change
steps: Sign in with a temporary password (new account or after a reset).
Try to open / or a project.
cases.expected: Sent to /account with a "choose a new password" message. Every other page sends you back there.

cases.title: Password change validation
steps: On /account: wrong current password; mismatched new passwords; a new password under 10 characters; new = current.
cases.expected: A specific error each time, and nothing changes.

cases.title: Password change works
steps: Change the password properly.
Sign out, sign in with the old one, then the new one.
cases.expected: Lands on home after the change. Old password fails, new one works. No passwords ever appear in the address bar.

cases.title: Changing password signs out other browsers
steps: Sign in on two browsers.
Change the password in one.
Use the other.
cases.expected: The other browser is sent to sign-in. The one you changed it in stays signed in.

cases.title: Sign out ends the session
steps: Sign out.
Press Back, and reload.
cases.expected: Sign-in page; the previous page's data doesn't come back.

cases.title: User menu
steps: Look at the header on home and inside a project.
cases.expected: Your name, Account and Sign out everywhere. An Admin link only for superadmins.

cases.title: Session survives a normal day
steps: Stay signed in, use the app on and off for a few hours.
cases.expected: No surprise sign-outs (sessions last 12 h idle, 7 days at most).

cases.title: Home shows only my projects
steps: Open home.
cases.expected: Only projects you're on, each with a Curator badge. No New project button, no ⋮ menu.

cases.title: Empty home for someone on no projects
steps: Open home as the outsider.
cases.expected: "You're not on any projects yet. Ask a project manager…"

cases.title: Manager controls are hidden
steps: Open the project.
cases.expected: No Add Paper(s), Run extraction…, Import, Download, Jobs or Team.

cases.title: Work queue sections and filter
steps: Look at the paper list.
Use the status filter.
cases.expected: My papers, Pool and a collapsed Others. Every row has a status badge, and the assignee's name when it isn't you. The filter narrows the list and is remembered after reload.

cases.title: Unclaimed paper is read-only
steps: Open a paper from Pool.
Try to type in a value, tick confirm, select text in the PDF.
cases.expected: Banner says to claim it first. Inputs and confirm are disabled, and the PDF selection offers no "+ Add to".

cases.title: Claim a paper
steps: Press Claim.
cases.expected: The paper moves to My papers as In progress, and the inputs become editable.

cases.title: Autosave and attribution
steps: Change a value, wait a moment, reload the page.
cases.expected: The value is still there, the AI's value is still shown beside it, and it says "edited by <you> · time".

cases.title: Confirm and unconfirm
steps: Confirm a value, then unconfirm it.
cases.expected: "confirmed by <you>" appears, then disappears.

cases.title: Set a value from the PDF
steps: Select text in the PDF and apply it to a single-value field, a list field, and a fixed-choice field.
cases.expected: Replaces, appends, or matches the allowed value respectively. Saved after reload.

cases.title: Repeating group entries
steps: On a paper with variants: edit a row, add a row, delete an AI row, mark the list complete.
cases.expected: All saved after reload. A deleted AI row is kept as deleted, not erased. "confirmed by" on the list.

cases.title: Evidence and view modes
steps: Click a value's evidence.
Switch between list and card mode.
cases.expected: The PDF scrolls to and highlights the passage. Card mode highlights each field's evidence as you step through.

cases.title: Submit
steps: Press Submit and confirm.
cases.expected: Status Submitted, read-only banner, inputs disabled.

cases.title: Exclude needs a reason
steps: Claim another paper, press Exclude… and submit an empty reason.
Then give a reason.
cases.expected: Inline error first. Then status Excluded, with the reason shown.

cases.title: Unextractable with a reason
steps: On another claimed paper, press Unextractable… with a reason.
cases.expected: Status Unextractable, reason shown, read-only.

cases.title: Someone else's paper is read-only
steps: Open a paper assigned to C2.
cases.expected: Banner "Assigned to C2 — read only". Nothing editable.

cases.title: History
steps: Open History on a paper you've worked on.
cases.expected: Claim, submit or exclude events with names, times and reasons.

cases.title: View settings are personal
steps: C1 opens paper A and zooms; C2 opens paper B in the same project.
Both reload.
cases.expected: Each gets back their own paper and zoom; neither moves the other's view.

cases.title: Export is refused
steps: Open /api/projects/<pid>/export?format=csv directly.
cases.expected: A 403 error, no file.

cases.title: Admin page is refused
steps: Open /admin.
cases.expected: Refused (403), no admin data.

cases.title: Joining through an invite link
steps: While signed in, open an invite link for another project.
cases.expected: "Join … as a curator?", then lands inside that project as a curator.

cases.title: Outsider can't see a project
steps: Open /p/<pid> of a project you're not on.
cases.expected: The app treats it as not found and goes back home with a message.

cases.title: Home card for a manager
steps: Open home.
cases.expected: Manager badge; ⋮ menu offers the config and export downloads, but no Archive.

cases.title: Create a project
steps: New project → fill in details, features, review → create.
cases.expected: You land in it as its manager; it appears on home.

cases.title: Edit the schema
steps: Change a feature description, add a field, break a rule (e.g. empty name).
cases.expected: Validation error for the broken rule; prompt preview updates; save works.

cases.title: Import one PMID
steps: Add Paper(s) → one PMID with a free PDF.
cases.expected: A row goes waiting → running → added, and the paper appears in Pool.

cases.title: Import a mixed batch
steps: Paste: a good PMID twice, one already in the project, a paywalled one, 99999999.
cases.expected: One row per distinct PMID: added, already in project, no open-access PDF, not found. Duplicates in the list collapse into one row.

cases.title: Upload the PDF for a no-PDF row
steps: On the "no open-access PDF" row, press Upload PDF for this PMID and pick the PDF.
cases.expected: The paper is added with that PMID already filled in.

cases.title: Import keeps going without the tab
steps: Start a batch of ~10 PMIDs and close the modal right away.
Open Jobs.
cases.expected: The job keeps running; papers keep appearing; Jobs shows its progress.

cases.title: Retry failed import items
steps: On a finished job with failures, press Retry failed.
cases.expected: A new job containing only the failed PMIDs.

cases.title: Cancel a running import
steps: Start a large batch and press Cancel.
cases.expected: Items already running finish; the rest become cancelled; the job ends as cancelled.

cases.title: Upload PDFs directly
steps: Upload one PDF, then several, then the same PDF again under another file name.
cases.expected: Each added once; the repeat is reported as already in the project. Uploaded papers ask for their PMID.

cases.title: Confirm identity on any paper
steps: Confirm a PMID (or mark "no PMID" if the project allows it) on a paper assigned to a curator.
cases.expected: Allowed for a manager.

cases.title: Declare variants on any paper
steps: Edit a paper's variant list while it's assigned to C1.
cases.expected: Allowed for a manager; C1 sees the new rows.

cases.title: Extract one paper
steps: Run extraction… on the open paper with one model.
cases.expected: Progress shown; when done, the run appears with AI values and evidence.

cases.title: Extraction without variants listed
steps: Run extraction on a paper whose variant list is empty (project with a repeating group).
cases.expected: That item fails with a clear message to add the entries first.

cases.title: Bulk extraction
steps: Run extraction… → every paper lacking a run for the chosen models.
cases.expected: The count shown matches; one job with a row per paper; runs appear as items finish.

cases.title: Re-running with force
steps: Re-run extraction with force on a paper a curator has edited.
cases.expected: Note what happens to the curator's edits (expected: replaced by the new run — decide if that needs a warning).

cases.title: Assign, reassign, return to pool
steps: Assign a Pool paper to C1, reassign it to C2, then choose Pool (unassigned).
cases.expected: Status and assignee follow each change; History records each step.

cases.title: Assign list shows only the team
steps: Open the Assign to list.
cases.expected: Only current, active project members, plus Pool.

cases.title: Reopen a finished paper
steps: Reopen a submitted paper with a reason.
cases.expected: Back to In progress with the same curator; the reason is in History.

cases.title: Managers can't edit around a curator
steps: Open a paper assigned to C1 and try to edit a value.
cases.expected: Read-only; reassigning is the only way.

cases.title: Manager curates their own paper
steps: Assign a paper to yourself and curate it.
cases.expected: Editable; attribution shows your name.

cases.title: Add a curator
steps: Team → Add person → pick someone from the directory.
cases.expected: They appear as curator. The manager role isn't offered to you.

cases.title: Remove a curator who has work
steps: Remove a curator who has in-progress papers.
cases.expected: They leave the team; their in-progress papers go back to Pool; submitted ones keep their name.

cases.title: Managers can't remove managers
steps: Look for a Remove button on another manager.
cases.expected: Not offered (only a superadmin can).

cases.title: Create an invite link
steps: Team → Create link (7 days, max 2 uses) → Copy.
cases.expected: The full URL is shown once with Copy; the list shows it as valid with 0/2 uses.

cases.title: Revoke an invite link
steps: Revoke the link.
cases.expected: State revoked; opening it says it's no longer valid.

cases.title: Export
steps: Download CSV and audit JSON.
cases.expected: CSV opens in a spreadsheet; JSON includes users, events (claim/assign/submit…) and edited/confirmed-by ids.

cases.title: Config file round trip
steps: Download the config file, create a new project from it.
cases.expected: Same features, models and prompts in the new project.

cases.title: Jobs panel
steps: Open Jobs during and after a run; view items; cancel; retry.
cases.expected: Kind, state, counts, time and who started it; actions only where they apply.

cases.title: First start creates the superadmin
steps: Start the server with the env admin set (password ≥ 10 characters).
Sign in.
cases.expected: Startup log says the superadmin was set up; sign-in forces a password change.

cases.title: Approve and reject sign-ups
steps: Admin → Pending: approve one request as user, another as manager, reject a third.
cases.expected: The Pending badge counts down. Approved people can sign in; the rejected one is told the request wasn't approved.

cases.title: Create a user
steps: Users → Create user.
cases.expected: A dialog shows a temporary password once, with Copy and a "won't be shown again" warning.

cases.title: Reset a password
steps: Reset a signed-in user's password.
cases.expected: New temporary password shown once; that user is signed out at their next click.

cases.title: Deactivate and reactivate
steps: Deactivate an active user, then reactivate them.
cases.expected: They're signed out at once and can't sign in; after reactivation they can. Their past edits still show their name.

cases.title: Change account roles
steps: Make a user a manager; make a manager a user.
cases.expected: The new manager can create projects (after reload); the demoted one can't.

cases.title: Guard rails
steps: Try to deactivate yourself.
Try to demote the only superadmin.
cases.expected: Both refused with a clear message.

cases.title: All projects, including archived
steps: Admin → Projects.
cases.expected: Every project, with managers, paper and finished counts, members, archived state.

cases.title: Archive and unarchive
steps: Archive a project (Admin or home ⋮ menu), then unarchive it.
cases.expected: Archived: gone from members' home and unreachable; Open disabled in Admin. Unarchived: back for everyone.

cases.title: Add and remove project managers
steps: Add a second manager to a project; remove one; try to remove the last one.
cases.expected: First two work; the last-manager removal is refused.

cases.title: Open any project
steps: Open a project you're not a member of.
cases.expected: Full manager view of it.

cases.title: System tab
steps: Admin → System.
cases.expected: Version, database size, extraction on/off, backups, job counts, user counts, recent errors (or "No errors since the server started").

cases.title: Back up and download
steps: Back up now; then Download database snapshot.
cases.expected: A new backup appears in the list with the current time; the snapshot downloads as a .db file. Repeated downloads don't add to the backup list.

cases.title: A paper's whole life
steps: Anon: request an account.
SA: approve it.
PM: add the person to the project, import a paper, extract it, assign it to them.
C1: curate, confirm, submit.
PM: reopen with a reason.
C1: fix and submit again.
PM: export the audit JSON.
cases.expected: Every step works; the export shows who edited and confirmed each value, and every claim/assign/submit/reopen with times.

cases.title: New person through an invite link
steps: PM: create an invite link.
Anon: open it and request an account through it.
SA: approve.
New person: sign in.
cases.expected: Approval says they were added to the project; after sign-in they're in it as a curator.

cases.title: Existing user, signed out, opens a link
steps: PM: create a link.
C2 (signed out): open it and sign in.
cases.expected: After sign-in they join and land in the project.

cases.title: Two curators claim at once
steps: Both open the same Pool paper.
Both press Claim at nearly the same moment.
cases.expected: One gets it; the other is told it's already taken by the winner, and sees it read-only.

cases.title: Reassigned while editing
steps: C1: start editing a paper.
PM: reassign it to C2.
C1: edit again.
C2: open it.
cases.expected: C1's next save is refused with a message and the paper turns read-only. C2 can edit.

cases.title: Removed while working
steps: C1: working in the project.
PM: remove C1 from the team.
C1: click anything.
cases.expected: C1 loses the project and is sent home; C1's in-progress papers are back in Pool.

cases.title: Deactivated while working
steps: C1: working.
SA: deactivate C1.
C1: click anything.
cases.expected: C1 is sent to the sign-in page and can't sign back in.

cases.title: Password reset while signed in
steps: C1: signed in.
SA: reset C1's password and hand over the temporary one.
C1: click anything, then sign in with the temporary password.
cases.expected: Signed out, then forced to choose a new password.

cases.title: Two curators, one project, half an hour
steps: Both curate different papers in the same project for 30 minutes, reloading now and then.
cases.expected: No lost or crossed edits; each value names the right person.

cases.title: Reopened while the curator watches
steps: C1: viewing their submitted paper.
PM: reopen it.
C1: reload.
cases.expected: Editable again for C1.

cases.title: Extraction while a curator is on the paper
steps: C1: curating a paper with one model's run.
PM: extract it with a second model (no force).
C1: reload.
cases.expected: The new model's run appears; C1's edits on the first run are untouched.

cases.title: Promotion takes effect
steps: SA: make C1 a manager account.
C1: reload home.
cases.expected: C1 now has New project.

cases.title: Promoted to project manager
steps: SA: add C1 as a manager of the project (Admin → Projects).
C1: reload the project.
cases.expected: C1 now sees Add Paper(s), Jobs, Team and the assign controls.

cases.title: Archived under people's feet
steps: C1: in the project.
SA: archive it.
C1: click anything.
SA: unarchive.
cases.expected: C1 loses access, then gets it back with nothing lost.

cases.title: Name survives deactivation
steps: C1: confirm some values.
SA: deactivate C1.
PM: open those values and export.
cases.expected: Still "confirmed by C1" in the app and in the export.

cases.title: Single-use invite link
steps: PM: create a link with max uses 1.
C2: join with it.
O: try the same link.
cases.expected: C2 joins; O is told the link is no longer valid.

cases.title: Two projects, two tabs
steps: Open project A and project B in two tabs; work in both.
cases.expected: No crossover of papers, view or saves between the tabs.

cases.title: HTTPS and redirect
steps: Open http://<host>/ and https://<host>/.
cases.expected: HTTP redirects to HTTPS; the certificate is valid.

cases.title: Session cookie is Secure
steps: Sign in; browser dev tools → Application → Cookies.
cases.expected: annotaid_session is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax.

cases.title: Forms work through nginx
steps: Sign in, save a value, upload a PDF of ~20 MB.
cases.expected: No "did not come from this site" errors; the upload succeeds.

cases.title: Restart mid-job
steps: PM: start an import of ~10 PMIDs.
Sysadmin: systemctl restart annotaid.
PM: open Jobs.
cases.expected: Interrupted items say so; the rest finish; Retry failed re-runs only those.

cases.title: Restore from a backup
steps: Back up now; sysadmin follows RUNBOOK section 4 on a copy.
cases.expected: Projects, papers, values and accounts all present after restore.

cases.title: Upgrade and rollback
steps: Sysadmin deploys a new release tarball, then points the symlink back.
cases.expected: Both start cleanly; the version on Admin → System changes accordingly.

cases.title: Moving to the production domain
steps: Put the app on annotaid.afrigen-d.org with its own certificate.
cases.expected: Works with no code change; each domain has its own sign-ins; invite links show the domain they were made on.
